title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in VideoWhisper.com Video…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in VideoWhisper.com Video Share VOD up to version 3.15.1. This flaw allows an attacker to improperly limit pathname access, potentially leading to denial of service. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but can cause availability issues.
